title: As We Sing This Song
credit: Written and sung by Rachel Grace Ham
lyrics: As we sing this song, we will sing along,
As the people sing, we will sing His song,
As we worship Him, Christ Jesus is His name,
We will sing unto Him, this song of worship, a song of praise.
